items.title: Ignore `UV_NATIVE_TLS` when `UV_SYSTEM_CERTS` is set
items.reason: This predates the issue and covers the exact defect, making any `UV_SYSTEM_CERTS` value authoritative and testing false against true and invalid legacy values.

items.title: Avoid warning when both `UV_NATIVE_TLS` and `UV_SYSTEM_CERTS` are set
items.reason: This introduced the warning-suppression mismatch without changing precedence. Its review explicitly identified the same false/true corner case.

items.title: Remove the annoying message "`UV_NATIVE_TLS` environment variable is deprecated" when both variables are defined
items.reason: This originating warning report explains why users set both variables for compatibility, but does not isolate false-valued precedence.

related.search_scope: Searched literal identifiers, `UV_SYSTEM_CERTS=false`, deprecation-warning text, and ignore/fall-through wording across open and closed issues and pull requests in every state. Conceptual searches covered TLS-setting precedence, replacement environment variables, migration, and warning suppression. Fix-oriented inspection followed astral-sh/uv#21774, astral-sh/uv#21788, astral-sh/uv#21806, and astral-sh/uv#21805 through comments, reviews, diffs, tests, and cross-references. astral-sh/uv#21035 was ruled out because it concerns the broader deprecation timeline, while astral-sh/uv#21806 only concerns configuration files, where explicit false already wins.

type_reason: The source confirms incorrect behavior: warning suppression treats any present `UV_SYSTEM_CERTS` as authoritative, while resolution only treats true as authoritative. Duplicate takes precedence because open astral-sh/uv#21805 predates astral-sh/uv#21807 and already tracks and tests this exact defect; it was not created in response to the issue.
summary: Open astral-sh/uv#21805 is the exact tracker and fix. Merged astral-sh/uv#21788 created the warning/resolution mismatch, while astral-sh/uv#21774 provides the compatibility context.
draft_response: Thanks. This exact environment-variable precedence case is already being addressed in astral-sh/uv#21805, which predates this report. The current code suppresses the warning whenever `UV_SYSTEM_CERTS` is present but only gives it precedence when true, allowing false to fall through to `UV_NATIVE_TLS=true`. astral-sh/uv#21805 makes `UV_SYSTEM_CERTS` authoritative whenever set, ignores the deprecated variable, and adds coverage for true and invalid legacy values. We’ll centralize the fix there.
